status: First full-depth sample acquired and all references/indexes verified. Independent nucleotide baseline may run while final protein fixture and byte-parity gates complete; protein execution remains gated.
question: Does protein-space viral alignment recover final sample/species calls at full depth beyond nucleotide alignment, and which gains survive same-reference nucleotide validation?

references.viral_alignment: Same exact DUST-masked viral genome snapshot for Bowtie2 and six-frame translated DIAMOND index; verify source hashes. No curated reduction.
references.validation: Same comprehensive frozen core_nt snapshot in every arm; no NR or tblastx in this comparison.
references.prescreen: Retain original NT24 baseline. Use NT24 OR AA12 for both controlled alignment arms, because an upstream NT24-only gate can discard divergent reads before either aligner sees them.

execution_sharing: One acquired full-depth input per sample, shared between every output.
Reuse identical baseline RUN products between production and validation_control.
Share union-screen/FASTP inputs between screen_control and protein_variant.
Use the same human and other-contaminant algorithms/reference snapshots; maintain production ordering and verify identical retained reads when upstream candidate membership is identical.
Deduplicate only identical prepared validation query bytes with identical search parameters, then map each result back to its own original read; no verdict propagation between different reads.

contrasts.protein_variant-screen_control: Alignment effect on identical screened/trimmed reads
contrasts.protein_variant-production: Complete proposed pipeline versus original pipeline

implementation_gate.critical_adapter: Map real DIAMOND six-frame HSPs back to original nucleotide genomes, orientation and unclipped coordinates required by production alignment-duplicate marking. Do not fabricate Bowtie2 scores, SAM CIGARs, or missing coordinates.
invariants_to_pin: All original pair IDs, both original sequence/quality strings and member multiplicities survive mapping.
Six reference frames and both query strands yield correct reference bounds and unclipped 5-prime endpoints, including clipped and gapped HSPs.
Unaligned mates remain unaligned; one-mate and different-reference pairs follow existing duplicate keys.
Taxonomy stays attached to each read; validation cannot transfer between cluster members.
Baseline path and sampling unchanged by enabling experimental modules; existing baseline outputs replay identically.
Hash sampling and production merge/join are deterministic and follow per-species/per-group cap20.
The original alignment-plus-similarity duplicate machinery consumes real reconstructed coordinates; supplemental similarity-only support is not substituted.
existing_evidence: Prior pinned similarity fixture reproduced locally, but does not cover the new coordinate adapter.
Rust alignment duplicate integration tests pin existing coordinate/orientation semantics.
Existing baseline output archives and sampled-query preparations are parity fixtures.

budget: Fresh $500 USD cap authorized for this end-to-end run, replacing the prior cap remainder. Target all initial10 if measured total fits. Prior experiments are accounted separately.

claim_corrections.overstatement: Megablast does not mostly return no alignment in this panel:131/200 return an alignment.
claim_corrections.storage: 143GiB raw NR is about$3.28/month at prior Standard rate, about20% of the prior$16.49/month total; not most storage cost.

acquisition: Every spot from NCBI normalized full-quality SRA, with source integrity checks, exact paired spot counts and original quality values. Canonical accession.spot/mate headers are shared by every arm. ENA download attempt was too slow and was abandoned before analysis.
grouping: Each original sample is its own downstream group; cap20 per species per sample.
runtime_contract: Nested Nextflow entry points use the existing root bin through the committed relative symlink.
Every full-depth or protein-fixture invocation explicitly loads the unchanged root lib directory (SortUtils and SentinelUtils).
Root main.nf handles production RUN and DOWNSTREAM; protein and postscreen entry points reuse the same module implementations.
A complete real-protein-to-validation fixture must pass before full-depth protein execution.

Bounded adapter must preserve decompressed candidate FASTQ and every final TSV field byte-for-byte on the real-reference integration fixture before full-depth protein execution. All HSPs remain in saved evidence; only processing order and memory use change.
